  RootPackage
  class FailureGate(var waiter: Continuation<Int>?)
    fun fail
  class FailureRegistration(val gate: FailureGate), SuspendRegistration<Int>
    public fun register
  class CaughtTask(val gate: FailureGate), SuspendTask<Int>
    public suspend fun run
  class UncaughtTask(val gate: FailureGate), SuspendTask<Int>
    public suspend fun run
  class RecordingCompletion(), Continuation<Int>
    public fun resume
    public fun resumeWithException
  fun launch(task: SuspendTask<Int>, completion: Continuation<Int>)
    Call startCoroutine
      Var task
      Var completion
  fun main()
    val caught
      Call FailureGate
        Var None
    val uncaught
      Call FailureGate
        Var None
    Call launch
      Call CaughtTask
        Var caught
      Call RecordingCompletion
    Call launch
      Call UncaughtTask
        Var uncaught
      Call RecordingCompletion
    Call println
      StringLiteral "returned"
    MethodCall fail
      Var caught
    MethodCall fail
      Var uncaught
